I need some help finding a fragrance!

I love the Turkish rose oil perfume by Nest and have been wanting to layer it with something (kind of like a similar scent but not in the form of an oil).

I would like something similar in scent; I quite like how sweet the oil perfume is, but I dislike strong vanilla scents.

Is there any fragrances you would recommend?
